verdict.rationale: Orb documents a first-party, real-time webhooks system that calls an endpoint of your choosing when certain events occur. The evidence does not say which events are covered, so it does not show that renewal, upgrade, payment-failure and cancellation each emit an event. Dunning retries and plan changes are documented, but nothing links them to webhook emission. Missing for 10: an enumerated subscription lifecycle event catalog (renewal, plan change, payment failure, cancellation), webhook delivery reliability guarantees (retries, signatures, ordering), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, every subscription state change — renewal, upgrade, payment failure, cancellation — emits a webhook or event my systems can act on reliably

citations.quote: Orb provides a powerful, real-time webhooks system that can issue calls to an endpoint of your choosing when certain events take place.
